# Word Unscrambler

Free English word unscrambler and anagram solver for Scrabble, Wordle, jumble and crossword puzzles.

- Site: https://lettersunscrambler.com/
- Dictionary: ENABLE (~168,000 words), scored with Scrabble and Words With Friends points
- Instant solver: https://lettersunscrambler.com/?q=LISTEN
- Example (HTML): https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/listen
- Examples index: https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble
- Bingo stem: https://lettersunscrambler.com/unscramble/aeinrst
- Contact: https://lettersunscrambler.com/contact
- Wildcards: use ? for a blank tile (max two)

## Tools

- Anagram solver: https://lettersunscrambler.com/anagram-solver
- Scrabble word finder: https://lettersunscrambler.com/scrabble-word-finder
- Words With Friends: https://lettersunscrambler.com/words-with-friends
- Wordle helper: https://lettersunscrambler.com/wordle-helper
- Jumble solver: https://lettersunscrambler.com/jumble-solver
- Crossword solver: https://lettersunscrambler.com/crossword-solver
